 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2020-25',ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'))]:

  print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20281214_stress_rebound_quality_signal.csv',index_label='date')"}

   - For each asset, estimated rolling 60-day beta to the proxy.
   - Computed 30-day cumulative beta-neutral residual return.
   - Scaled by 40-day annualized residual volatility:
     \[
     \frac{\sum_{30}(r_i-\beta_i r_m)}
     {1+\sigma_{40,\mathrm{annualized}}(r_i-\beta_i r_m)}
     \]

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-02-07')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Tail-resilient momentum: medium-term return rewarded, but penalized by downside deviation and persistent drawdown.
ret=px.pct_change(30)
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
dd=px/px.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()-1
f=(ret/(1+4*down+(-dd))).shift(1)
print('factor tail_resilient_momentum universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); N.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',len(z))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290208_tail_resilient_momentum_signal.csv',index_label='date')

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-02-07')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Tail-resilient momentum: medium-term return rewarded, but penalized by downside deviation and persistent drawdown.
ret=px.pct_change(30)
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
dd=px/px.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()-1
f=(ret/(1+4*down+(-dd))).shift(1)
print('factor tail_resilient_momentum universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); N.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',len(z))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290208_tail_resilient_momentum_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-03-07')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Recovery-confirmed rebound: recent 10d trend, rewarded when price is well above its 60d low,
# and penalized by downside volatility; lag one completed session.
r10=px.pct_change(10)
loc=px/px.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min()-1
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(r10*loc/(1+2*down)).shift(1)
print('factor recovery_confirmed_rebound_10_60 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',len(z))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290308_recovery_confirmed_rebound_signal.csv',index_label='date')

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y'];cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-03-07')

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-03-08

### Explored Factors

1. **Recovery-Confirmed Rebound**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \frac{R_{10}\times(\text{close}/\text{60d rolling low}-1)}
     {1+2\sigma_{\text{down},40}}
     \]
   - Combines short-term return with recovery from the 60-day low and penalizes downside volatility.
   - Lagged by one completed trading day.
   - Tested across all 15 tradable instruments.

2. **Breadth-Quality Volatility-Scaled Trend**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \frac{R_{20}\times\text{positive-day breadth}_{40}}
     {1+\sigma_{40}}
     \]
   - Rewards medium-term trend strength when supported by a high fraction of positive daily sessions, with volatility scaling.
   - Lagged by one completed trading day.
   - Tested across all 15 tradable instruments.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-03-21')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Consistency-adjusted long trend: 60d return, supported by recent positive-day breadth,
# penalized only by downside volatility; lagged one completed session.
bread=(r>0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean(); dn=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(px.pct_change(60)*bread/(1+2*dn)).shift(1)
print('factor consistency_downside_trend_60_20_40', 'dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'through',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6) if len(z)>1 else None,'dates',len(z))

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-03-22

### Explored Factors

**Consistency-Adjusted Downside Trend**

Construction:

\[
F_t =
\frac{R_{60,t}\times \text{Positive-Day Breadth}_{20,t}}
{1+2\sigma_{\text{down},40,t}}
\]

- \(R_{60}\): 60-trading-day return.
- Positive-day breadth: fraction of positive-return sessions over the past 20 days.
- Downside volatility: 40-day downside volatility, annualized.
- Signal lagged by one completed trading day.
- Tested across all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
- Data available through 2029-03-21.

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 3,021 | 15.0 | 0.009393 | 0.027152 | 50.22% |
| 10d | 3,016 | 15.0 | 0.003054 | 0.008912 | 50.99% |
| 20d | 3,006 | 15.0 | -0.003863 | -0.010857 | 49.90% |

Additional metrics:

- Coverage: 99.99%.
- Dates with at least eight valid instruments: 3,026.
- Rank turnover: 0.051577.
- The factor failed the benchmark admission gates of absolute IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute ICIR ≥ 0.0840 at every tested horizon.

#### Regime performance

At the 20-day horizon:

- 2020–2025: IC 0.004600, ICIR 0.013041.
- 2026+: IC -0.024441, ICIR -0.067414.
- 2027+: IC approximately 0, ICIR approximately 0.
- 2028+: IC 0.076486, ICIR 0.260637.
- 2029+: IC -0.001692, ICIR -0.007236.

The strong 2028 result was not persistent into 2029 and was insufficient to support full-period admission.

### Persistence Actions

- No factor was persisted as effective.
- The research script generated the signal artifact:
  - `scripts/miner_2_20290322_consistency_downside_trend_signal.csv`
- No JSON factor file was created because the candidate failed both admission requirements.

### Current Effective Factors

Based on the latest available validations:

- `breadth_quality_trend_20_40`
  - 20-day IC: 0.046975.
  - 20-day ICIR: 0.134826.
  - Validated 2029-03-08.
  - Broad coverage and relatively low turnover.

- `relative_return_acceleration_20_60`
  - 20-day IC: 0.065281.
  - 20-day ICIR: 0.192380.
  - Validated 2029-02-22.
  - Still pending deterministic library-correlation checks and ongoing drift monitoring.

The new consistency-adjusted trend candidate is not effective.

### Plans

- Continue testing defensive relative-strength and cross-asset leadership factors that are less correlated with the existing momentum/trend cluster.
- Prioritize signals with stable performance after 2026 rather than relying on the strong 2028 regime.
- Revalidate `breadth_quality_trend_20_40` and `relative_return_acceleration_20_60` using the expanded 2029 sample.
- Investigate whether downside asymmetry or macro-conditioned leadership can improve recent trend-factor weakness without materially increasing turnover.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-04-19')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Trend persistence efficiency: medium horizon return scaled by directional path efficiency
# and penalized by downside volatility; all inputs lagged one day.
ret=px.pct_change(60)
path=r.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=40).sum()
eff=ret.abs()/path
sign=np.sign(ret)
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(sign*eff*ret.abs()/(1+3*down)).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('factor medium_persistent_trend_60 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2020-25',ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]
  print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290419_medium_persistent_trend_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-04-19')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Short-horizon reversal only when the preceding move is unusually large relative to its own volatility.
r5=px.pct_change(5); v20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); shock=(r5.abs()/(v20*np.sqrt(5))).clip(0,6)
f=(-r5*shock).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('factor volatility_scaled_shock_reversal_5 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2020-25',ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mk]
  print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y'];cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-04-19')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U};idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]));px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill();r=px.pct_change()
# Medium-term momentum normalized by realized total volatility, lagged one day.
f=(px.pct_change(40)/(r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(40))).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('factor vol_normalized_momentum_40 universe',15,'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I);ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds);print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mk in [('2020-25',ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[mk];print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mk.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift()).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()));f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290419_vol_normalized_momentum_signal.csv',index_label='date')

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-05-02')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Path-efficiency momentum: net 30-session return divided by total absolute movement; lagged one day.
path=(px.pct_change(30)/(r.abs().rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum())).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('path_efficiency_30 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([path.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-05-16')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Volatility-scaled short-horizon shock reversal: negative 5-session return divided by trailing 20-session volatility, lagged one completed day.
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=(-px.pct_change(5)/vol).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('shock_reversal_5_vol20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2020-25',ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m]; print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift()).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6));f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290517_shock_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

from scipy.stats import spearmanr

## Explored Factors

1. **Volatility-Scaled Short-Horizon Shock Reversal**
   - Construction: negative 5-day return divided by trailing 20-day annualized volatility, lagged by one completed trading day.
   - Motivation: identify assets that experienced unusually large recent declines and may mean-revert.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Validation used only information available through **2029-05-16**.

2. **Stable-Volatility Quality**
   - Construction: inverse of 40-day annualized realized volatility, lagged by one completed trading day.
   - Motivation: favor assets with lower realized volatility as a defensive quality/risk-control signal.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Validation used only information available through **2029-05-16**.

## Validation Results

### Volatility-Scaled Shock Reversal

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5D | 3,106 | 14.93 | 0.001106 | 0.003615 | 49.94% | 99.51% |
| 10D | 3,101 | 14.93 | -0.001084 | -0.003483 | 48.89% | 99.52% |
| 20D | 3,091 | 14.93 | -0.015387 | -0.048916 | 48.17% | 99.54% |

The factor failed both admission metrics. Its 2029 20-day IC was positive at 0.030318 with ICIR 0.096424, but this recent subsample was not sufficient to offset weak full-sample results. Rank turnover was 0.156958.

### Stable-Volatility Quality

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5D | 3,096 | 14.93 | -0.015179 | -0.042854 | 48.64% | 99.55% |
| 10D | 3,091 | 14.93 | -0.022671 | -0.065384 | 49.30% | 99.56% |
| 20D | 3,081 | 14.94 | -0.015284 | -0.045392 | 49.89% | 99.58% |

The factor passed the absolute IC threshold at 20D but failed the ICIR threshold of 0.0840. It showed strong recent regime behavior:

- 2028 onward, 20D IC: 0.138914; ICIR: 0.519671
- 2029 YTD, 20D IC: 0.100028; ICIR: 0.423136

However, the full-sample result was negative, including 2020–2025 IC of -0.033098 and ICIR of -0.093609. Rank turnover was only 0.014437, indicating a stable but regime-dependent signal.

## Persistence Actions

- No factors met both benchmark admission gates:
  - Absolute daily paper IC ≥ 0.0070
  - Absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ 0.0840
- Therefore, no new factor was persisted.
- Research signal artifacts were generated for audit and future analysis:
  - `scripts/miner_2_20290517_shock_reversal_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_2_20290517_stable_vol_signal.csv`

## Current Effective Factors

No new effective factors were admitted in this cycle.

Previously persisted effective factors remain subject to their existing validation records and deterministic library-correlation checks, including the recently admitted **Path-Efficiency Momentum 30D** factor. Its severe 2029 deterioration remains relevant when screening or conditioning its use.

## Plans

- Investigate regime-conditioned stable-volatility signals, given their strong 2028–2029 performance but poor earlier history.
- Test volatility quality combined with cross-asset breadth or macro regime indicators such as VIX, without trading observation-only instruments.
- Revalidate existing momentum and defensive factors using recent rolling windows to identify deterioration or regime-specific inversion.
- Avoid admitting either candidate until performance is robust across a broader historical sample and satisfies both IC and ICIR gates.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-05-30')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Cross-sectional acceleration: recent 20-session trend relative to its 60-session baseline,
# residualized cross-sectionally and scaled by realized risk; only lagged data are used.
r20=px.pct_change(20); r60=px.pct_change(60); accel=r20-r60/3
resid=accel.sub(accel.mean(axis=1),axis=0); vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std(); breadth=r20.gt(0).mean(axis=1)
# broad participation confirms continuation; centered breadth avoids directional market beta
confirm=(0.5+(breadth-0.5).abs()).clip(0.5,1.0)
f=(resid/(vol+0.005)).mul(confirm,axis=0).shift(1)
print('factor xs_acceleration_risk_40d universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,mask in [('2020-25',(ds>=pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'))&(ds<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
  q=a[mask]; print(lab,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum())); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290531_xs_acceleration_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-06-13')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill()
r=px.pct_change()
# Dispersion-gated short-term reversal: fade the lagged 5d move, scaled by 20d risk,
# with stronger signal when cross-asset 20d return dispersion is elevated.
csdisp=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(axis=1)
raw=-px.pct_change(5)/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)+1e-8)
f=(raw*(1+csdisp/(csdisp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).median()+1e-8))).shift(1)
print('factor dispersion_gated_reversal_risk_5_20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); N.append(len(q))
 a=np.asarray(I)
 print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 for label,lo in [('2020-25','2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01')]:
  z=[]
  for i in range(len(px)-h):
   if px.index[i]<pd.Timestamp(lo): continue
   q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
   if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:z.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic)
  z=np.asarray(z); print(' ',label,len(z),round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,round(z.mean()/(z.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6) if len(z)>1 else None)
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290614_dispersion_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-06-13')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Daily cross-sectional dispersion smoothed over 20 sessions; lag all inputs one session.
csdisp=r.std(axis=1).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()
raw=-px.pct_change(5)/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)+1e-8)
f=(raw*(1+csdisp/(csdisp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).median()+1e-8))).shift(1)
print('factor dispersion_gated_reversal_risk_5_20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.asarray(I); print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),4))
 if h==10:
  for label,lo in [('2020-25','2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01')]:
   z=[]
   for i in range(len(px)-h):
    if px.index[i]<pd.Timestamp(lo):continue
    q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:z.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic)
   z=np.asarray(z);print(' ',label,len(z),round(z.mean(),6),round(z.mean()/(z.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),6))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290614_dispersion_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-06-27')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Payoff asymmetry: trend supported by repeated gains and limited losses, all lagged one session.
up=r.clip(lower=0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean(); dn=(-r.clip(upper=0)).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
trend=px.pct_change(20); asym=up.div(dn+1e-8).clip(0,10); breadth=r.gt(0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
f=(trend*asym*breadth).shift(1)
print('factor payoff_asymmetry_trend_20_30 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
def calc(lo=None,h=10):
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  if lo is not None and px.index[i]<pd.Timestamp(lo): continue
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.asarray(I); return len(a),np.mean(N),a.mean(),a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),(a>0).mean()
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 z=calc(h=h);print(h,'dates',z[0],'avgN',round(z[1],2),'IC',round(z[2],6),'ICIR',round(z[3],6),'hit',round(z[4],4))
for label,lo in [('2020-25','2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01')]:
 z=calc(lo,h=10);print(label,z[0],round(z[2],6),round(z[3],6),round(z[4],4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-07-11')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Path-efficiency trend: net 40d return relative to total absolute path, penalized by realized volatility; lag one session.
net=px.pct_change(40); path=r.abs().rolling(40,min_periods=30).sum(); vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(net/(path+1e-8)/(vol+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor path_efficiency_volscaled_40 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
def calc(lo=None,h=10):
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  if lo is not None and px.index[i]<pd.Timestamp(lo): continue
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.asarray(I); return len(a),np.mean(N),a.mean(),a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),(a>0).mean()
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 z=calc(h=h);print(h,'dates',z[0],'avgN',round(z[1],2),'IC',round(z[2],6),'ICIR',round(z[3],6),'hit',round(z[4],4))
for label,lo in [('2020-25','2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01')]:
 z=calc(lo,h=10);print(label,z[0],round(z[2],6),round(z[3],6),round(z[4],4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))

# Payoff asymmetry: trend supported by repeated gains and limited losses, all lagged one session.
up=r.clip(lower=0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean(); dn=(-r.clip(upper=0)).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
trend=px.pct_change(20); asym=up.div(dn+1e-8).clip(0,10); breadth=r.gt(0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()
f=(trend*asym*breadth).shift(1)
print('factor payoff_asymmetry_trend_20_30 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
def calc(lo=None,h=10):
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  if lo is not None and px.index[i]<pd.Timestamp(lo): continue
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.asarray(I); return len(a),np.mean(N),a.mean(),a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),(a>0).mean()
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 z=calc(h=h);print(h,'dates',z[0],'avgN',round(z[1],2),'IC',round(z[2],6),'ICIR',round(z[3],6),'hit',round(z[4],4))
for label,lo in [('2020-25','2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01')]:
 z=calc(lo,h=10);print(label,z[0],round(z[2],6),round(z[3],6),round(z[4],4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290628_payoff_asymmetry_signal.csv',index=False)
"}

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
raw={}
for s in U:
 d=get_index_daily_data(s,days=5000)
 if d is not None and len(d):
  x=d[['date','close']].copy(); x.date=pd.to_datetime(x.date); x=x.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float); raw[s]=x
p=pd.DataFrame(raw).sort_index().ffill()
# defensive recovery-adjusted trend: 20d return, penalize downside vol and current drawdown from 60d high
ret=p.pct_change()
down=ret.clip(upper=0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
dd=1-p/p.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()
f=(p.pct_change(20)/(down+1e-8))*np.exp(-3*dd)
# signal is lagged one completed day
f=f.shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
  fr=p.pct_change(h).shift(-h)
  vals=[]; dates=[]
  for dt in f.index:
   z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
   if len(z)>=8:
    vals.append(z[0].corr(z[1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt)
  a=np.array(vals); ic=np.nanmean(a); ir=ic/(np.nanstd(a,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(a)))
  print(h,len(a),len(p.columns),f.notna().mean().mean(),ic,ir,np.mean(a>0))
# recent 10d regimes
fr=p.pct_change(10).shift(-10); vals=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: vals.append((dt,z[0].corr(z[1],method='spearman')))
for name,mask in [('2020-25',lambda d:d<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',lambda d:d>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',lambda d:d>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',lambda d:d>='2029-01-01')]:
 a=np.array([v for d,v in vals if mask(d)]); print(name,len(a),np.nanmean(a),np.nanmean(a)/(np.nanstd(a,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(a))) if len(a)>1 else np.nan)
# rank turnover
r=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',r.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),'last',f.index[-1].date(),'dates',len(f))
# artifact
out=f.copy(); out.index.name='date'; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290726_recovery_downside_signal.csv')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-07-25')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Recovery-adjusted downside trend: 20d return / downside volatility, penalized by drawdown from 60d high; lagged.
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252); dd=1-px/px.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()
f=(px.pct_change(20)/(down+1e-8)*np.exp(-3*dd)).shift(1)
print('factor recovery_downside_trend universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
def calc(lo=None,h=10):
 I=[];N=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  if lo is not None and px.index[i]<pd.Timestamp(lo): continue
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q))
 a=np.asarray(I); return len(a),np.mean(N),a.mean(),a.mean()/(a.std(ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),(a>0).mean()
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 z=calc(h=h);print(h,'dates',z[0],'avgN',round(z[1],2),'IC',round(z[2],6),'ICIR',round(z[3],6),'hit',round(z[4],4))
for label,lo in [('2020-25','2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01')]:
 z=calc(lo,h=10);print(label,z[0],round(z[2],6),round(z[3],6),round(z[4],4))
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,6),'turnover',round(rr.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-08-08')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
prices={}
for s in syms:
 d=pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index()
 prices[s]=d[d.index<=cutoff]
p=pd.DataFrame(prices).sort_index()
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index().reindex(p.index).ffill()
# Macro-conditioned downside-resilient relative momentum. VIX stress is lagged and cross-sectionally
# changes the reward for positive momentum vs weak assets; all inputs end-of-day and signal is lagged.
r20=p.pct_change(20); r1=p.pct_change(); down=r1.where(r1<0).rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# VIX stress based only on trailing 60d percentile, capped; no lookahead
stress=(vix-vix.rolling(60).median())/(vix.rolling(60).std()+1e-9)
stress=stress.clip(-1,2).fillna(0)
rel=r20.sub(r20.median(axis=1),axis=0)
base_sig=rel/(down+0.02)
# stress rewards positive relative momentum and penalizes negative relative momentum asymmetrically
sig=base_sig*(1+0.35*stress.values[:,None]*np.tanh(rel*5))
sig=sig.shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1
 ics=[]; turns=[]; counts=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  a=sig.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   ics.append(spearmanr(a[ok],b[ok]).statistic); counts.append(ok.sum())
 # rank turnover at successive observations
 ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turns=ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna()
 ic=np.nanmean(ics); sd=np.nanstd(ics,ddof=1); icir=ic/sd*np.sqrt(252) if sd else np.nan
 rows.append((h,len(ics),ic,icir,np.mean(counts),turns.mean()))
print('cutoff',cutoff.date(),'dates',len(p),'avg instruments',p.notna().sum(axis=1).mean())
for x in rows: print('H',x[0],'dates',x[1],'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f avgN %.2f turnover %.6f'%x[2:])
# regime 10d
fwd=p.shift(-10)/p-1

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-08-22')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base=Path('../persistent/stock_data'); px={}
for s in syms:
 d=pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index()
 px[s]=d[d.index<=cutoff]
p=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change(); r40=p.pct_change(40)
# Medium-horizon relative trend, confirmed by directional breadth and penalized by downside risk.
rel=r40.sub(r40.median(axis=1),axis=0)
bread=(r>0).rolling(20,min_periods=10).mean()
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(30,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# rank-neutral confirmation: reward persistent positive paths, suppress unstable downside
confirm=(bread-0.5)*2
sig=(rel/(down+0.03))*(1+0.6*confirm)
sig=sig.shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   vals.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic); ns.append(ok.sum())
 vals=np.array(vals); print('H',h,'dates',len(vals),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f avgN %.2f hit %.4f'%(np.nanmean(vals),np.nanmean(vals)/np.nanstd(vals,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),np.mean(ns),np.mean(vals>0)))
 if h==20: 
  for name,mask in [('2020-25',sig.index<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',sig.index>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',sig.index>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',sig.index>='2029-01-01')]:
   x=[]
   for dt in sig.index[mask]:
    ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:x.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic)
   x=np.array(x); print(name,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(np.nanmean(x),np.nanmean(x)/np.nanstd(x,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)))
ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
out=sig; out.index.name='date'; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290823_breadth_confirmed_medium_trend_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-09-05')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base=Path('../persistent/stock_data'); px={}
for s in syms:
 d=pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index()
 px[s]=d[d.index<=cutoff]
p=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Higher-coverage trend-quality factor: relative 60d trend, conditioned on short-term recovery
# and penalized by downside semideviation. All inputs are lagged one completed day.
ret60=p.pct_change(60); rel=ret60.sub(ret60.median(axis=1),axis=0)
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
recovery=r.rolling(10,min_periods=7).mean()
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# recovery confirmation is bounded and volatility normalization avoids raw high-vol concentration
confirm=np.tanh(recovery/((vol/np.sqrt(252))+1e-6)*8)
sig=(rel/(down+0.025))*(1+0.45*confirm)
sig=sig.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   vals.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic); ns.append(ok.sum())
 vals=np.asarray(vals); ic=np.nanmean(vals); ir=ic/np.nanstd(vals,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)
 print(f'H {h} dates {len(vals)} IC {ic:.6f} ICIR {ir:.6f} avgN {np.mean(ns):.2f} hit {np.mean(vals>0):.4f}')
 if h in (10,20):
  for name,mask in [('2020-25',sig.index<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',sig.index>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',sig.index>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',sig.index>='2029-01-01')]:
   x=[]
   for dt in sig.index[mask]:
    ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:x.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic)
   x=np.asarray(x); print(name,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(np.nanmean(x),np.nanmean(x)/np.nanstd(x,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)))
ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.index.name='date'; sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290906_recovery_confirmed_trend_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-09-05')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base=Path('../persistent/stock_data'); close={}
for s in syms:
 d=pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index()
 close[s]=d[d.index<=cutoff]
# Compute each asset on its native observations, then align cross-section.
sigparts={}
for s,p in close.items():
 r=p.pct_change(); ret60=p.pct_change(60)
 down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
 recovery=r.rolling(10,min_periods=7).mean(); vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
 sigparts[s]=(ret60,down,recovery,vol)
idx=sorted(set().union(*[x.index for x in close.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:close[s].reindex(idx) for s in syms},index=idx)
ret60=pd.DataFrame({s:x[0].reindex(idx) for s,x in sigparts.items()}); down=pd.DataFrame({s:x[1].reindex(idx) for s,x in sigparts.items()}); rec=pd.DataFrame({s:x[2].reindex(idx) for s,x in sigparts.items()}); vol=pd.DataFrame({s:x[3].reindex(idx) for s,x in sigparts.items()})
rel=ret60.sub(ret60.median(axis=1),axis=0)
confirm=np.tanh(rec/((vol/np.sqrt(252))+1e-6)*8)
sig=(rel/(down+0.025))*(1+0.45*confirm); sig=sig.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic); ns.append(ok.sum())
 vals=np.asarray(vals); ic=np.nanmean(vals); ir=ic/np.nanstd(vals,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)
 print(f'H {h} dates {len(vals)} IC {ic:.6f} ICIR {ir:.6f} avgN {np.mean(ns):.2f} hit {np.mean(vals>0):.4f}')
 if h==20:
  for name,mask in [('2020-25',sig.index<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',sig.index>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',sig.index>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',sig.index>='2029-01-01')]:
   x=[]
   for dt in sig.index[mask]:
    ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:x.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic)
   x=np.asarray(x); print(name,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(np.nanmean(x),np.nanmean(x)/np.nanstd(x,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)))
ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.index.name='date';sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290906_recovery_confirmed_trend_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-09-19')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base=Path('../persistent/stock_data'); close={}
for s in syms:
 d=pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index()
 close[s]=d[d.index<=cutoff]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[x.index for x in close.values()]))
p=pd.DataFrame({s:close[s].reindex(idx) for s in syms},index=idx)
# Volatility-shock reversal: recent weakness is favored only when short-term vol has not exploded;
# cross-sectional ranks make the signal robust across heterogeneous asset scales.
sig=pd.DataFrame(index=idx,columns=syms,dtype=float)
for s in syms:
 x=close[s]; r=x.pct_change()
 ret5=x.pct_change(5); v20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); v60=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
 shock=(v20/(v60+1e-8)).clip(0.25,4)
 # contrarian short-term reversal, penalized by volatility shock and absolute risk
 raw=(-ret5/(v20+1e-8))/(1+0.8*(shock-1).clip(lower=0))
 sig[s]=raw.reindex(idx)
# lag to ensure no lookahead
sig=sig.shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   vals.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic); ns.append(ok.sum())
 vals=np.asarray(vals); ic=np.nanmean(vals); ir=ic/np.nanstd(vals,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)
 print(f'H {h} dates {len(vals)} IC {ic:.6f} ICIR {ir:.6f} avgN {np.mean(ns):.2f} hit {np.mean(vals>0):.4f}')
 if h==10:
  for name,mask in [('2020-25',sig.index<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',sig.index>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',sig.index>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',sig.index>='2029-01-01')]:
   x=[]
   for dt in sig.index[mask]:
    ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:x.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic)
   x=np.asarray(x); print(name,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(np.nanmean(x),np.nanmean(x)/np.nanstd(x,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)))
ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))

## Explored Factors

1. **Volatility-Shock Reversal**
   - Five-day short-term reversal, scaled by 20-day volatility.
   - Penalized when 20-day volatility exceeded its 60-day baseline, reducing exposure to volatility shocks.
   - Signals were lagged one completed trading day.
   - Tested across all 15 tradable instruments through **2029-09-19**.

2. **Stable Low-Volatility Quality**
   - Inverse 60-day volatility.
   - Further rewarded assets whose short-term volatility was not accelerating relative to the 60-day baseline.
   - Signals were lagged one completed trading day.
   - Tested across all 15 tradable instruments through **2029-09-19**.

## Validation Results

### Volatility-Shock Reversal

| Horizon | Dates | IC | ICIR | Avg. instruments |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

- Rank turnover: **0.187426**
- Minimum cross-sectional requirement: 8 instruments
- Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20290920_volshock_reversal_signal.csv`

The factor failed admission. Its daily IC was negative and below the absolute IC threshold, while the 5-day result was positive but also below the daily admission horizon requirement. Longer-horizon results were negative.

Regime results at the 10-day horizon:

| Regime | Dates | IC | ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2020–2025 | 580 | -0.009670 | -0.442965 |
| 2026 onward | 873 | 0.007752 | 0.441061 |
| 2028 onward | 438 | -0.015705 | -0.905457 |
| 2029 YTD | 178 | -0.015530 | -0.937042 |

The factor exhibited unstable regime behavior and deteriorated materially in 2028–2029.

### Stable Low-Volatility Quality

| Horizon | Dates | IC | ICIR | Avg. instruments |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1D | 1,801 | 0.001177 | 0.055235 | 14.55 |

The factor failed the admission gates. Daily IC and ICIR were both below the required thresholds:

- Required absolute daily IC: **0.0070**
- Required absolute daily ICIR: **0.0840**
- Observed daily IC/ICIR: **0.001177 / 0.055235**

Regime results at the 10-day horizon:

| Regime | Dates | IC | ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2020–2025 | 580 | -0.035841 | -1.536537 |
| 2026 onward | 873 | 0.024002 | 1.330830 |
| 2028 onward | 438 | 0.056401 | 3.215438 |
| 2029 YTD | 178 | -0.010754 | -0.676522 |

Although the factor was strong during 2028, it reversed sharply in 2029 YTD and lacks full-sample daily predictive strength.

## Persistence Actions

- **No factors persisted.**
- Neither candidate met the benchmark admission criteria.
- Signal artifacts were retained for audit and potential future conditional research.
- No existing factor files were modified.
- `max_abs_library_correlation` was not computed because neither candidate passed initial validation.

## Current Effective Factors

The existing factor library remains unchanged. No new factor became effective in this cycle.

Previously effective factors should continue to be treated cautiously given the recent deterioration of trend, reversal, and defensive signals documented in `memory.txt`.

## Plans

- Avoid persisting additional unconditional volatility or reversal variants.
- Investigate conditional factors that activate only under clearly defined macro-volatility regimes.
- Explore cross-asset leadership breadth, downside participation, and relative defensive strength using observation-only macro signals such as VIX and DXY without submitting orders for those instruments.
- Continue emphasizing recent-regime validation, especially 2028 onward and 2029 YTD, before admitting any factor.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
frames={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s,2600)
    if d is not None and len(d):
        x=d[['date','close']].copy(); x.date=pd.to_datetime(x.date); frames[s]=x.set_index('date').close
px=pd.DataFrame(frames).sort_index().ffill()
r=px.pct_change()
# Candidate: 5d payoff efficiency (return / downside deviation), gated by broad positive participation.
ret5=px.pct_change(5)
down=r.where(r<0).rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()
raw=ret5/(down*np.sqrt(5)+1e-8)
breadth=(r.rolling(5).gt(0).mean(axis=1)-0.5)
fac=raw.mul((1+0.8*breadth.clip(-.5,.5)),axis=0)
# one-day lag, forward horizons
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
    fwd=px.shift(-h)/px-1
    vals=[]
    for dt in fac.index:
        a=fac.loc[dt].shift(0); b=fwd.loc[dt]
        z=pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8: vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'))
    q=np.array(vals); print(h,len(q),round(np.nanmean(q),6),round(np.nanmean(q)/np.nanstd(q,ddof=1),6), 'avgN', round(np.nanmean([len(pd.concat([fac.loc[d],fwd.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()) for d in fac.index]),2))
# recent regime daily
for name,lo in [('2020-25','2020-01-01'),('2026+','2026-01-01'),('2028+','2028-01-01'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01')]:
    vals=[]
    fwd=px.shift(-1)/px-1
    for dt in fac.loc[lo:].index:
        z=pd.concat([fac.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8: vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'))
    q=np.array(vals); print(name,len(q),round(np.nanmean(q),6),round(np.nanmean(q)/np.nanstd(q,ddof=1),6))
print('coverage',fac.notna().mean().mean(),'dates',len(fac),'assets',len(px.columns))
print('turnover',fac.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
fac.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20291004_payoff_breadth_signal.csv')

import os, sys
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# Defensive relative-strength: medium horizon excess return, discounted by downside participation
raw={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=2600)
    if d is not None and len(d):
        x=d[['date','close']].copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x.date); x=x.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
        raw[s]=x
p=pd.DataFrame(raw).sort_index()
r=p.pct_change()
# signal at t: 20d excess return over cross-sectional median, divided by downside deviation
mom=p.pct_change(20)
down=r.where(r<0).rolling(40,min_periods=15).std()
# lower downside risk improves score; retain directional excess momentum
sig=(mom.sub(mom.median(axis=1),axis=0) / (down*np.sqrt(252)+0.02))
# lag to ensure completed data, and cross-sectional zscore
sig=sig.shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
    f=sig
    fr=p.pct_change(h).shift(-h)
    ics=[]
    for dt in f.index:
        a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(a)>=8:
            ics.append((dt,a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1]),len(a)))
    z=pd.DataFrame(ics,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
    print(f'H={h} dates={len(z)} avg_n={z.n.mean():.2f} IC={z.ic.mean():.6f} ICIR={z.ic.mean()/z.ic.std(ddof=1):.6f} hit={((z.ic>0).mean()):.3f}')
    for label, mask in [('2020-25',z.index<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',z.index>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',z.index>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',z.index>='2029-01-01')]:
        q=z.loc[mask]
        if len(q): print(f'  {label}: n={len(q)} IC={q.ic.mean():.6f} ICIR={q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1):.6f}')
    if h==1: daily=z
# artifact for daily admission signal
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20291018_defensive_relative_strength_signal.csv',index=False)
print('coverage=',sig.notna().mean().mean(),'dates=',len(sig),'instruments=',len(U))
# rank turnover
rank=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover=',rank.diff().abs().mean().mean())
print('signal_artifact=scripts/miner_2_20291018_defensive_relative_strength_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-10-31')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
close={s:pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index().loc[:cutoff] for s in syms}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[x.index for x in close.values()]))
p=pd.DataFrame({s:close[s].reindex(idx) for s in syms},index=idx)
r=p.pct_change()
# Tail asymmetry: medium-horizon gains are rewarded when downside participation is low;
# a breadth gate reduces trend exposure during broad weakness. Signal is lagged one day.
ret20=p.pct_change(20)
down=r.where(r<0).rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()
up=r.where(r>0).rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()
asym=(up+1e-8)/(down+1e-8)
breadth=r.gt(0).rolling(10,min_periods=10).mean().mean(axis=1)
gate=(0.5+0.8*(breadth-0.5).clip(-0.5,0.5))
sig=(ret20/(down*np.sqrt(20)+1e-8)*asym.clip(.5,2.0)).mul(gate,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for d in idx:
  ok=sig.loc[d].notna()&fwd.loc[d].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   vals.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[d,ok],fwd.loc[d,ok]).statistic);ns.append(ok.sum())
 z=np.asarray(vals); rows.append((h,len(z),np.nanmean(z),np.nanmean(z)/np.nanstd(z,ddof=1),np.mean(ns),np.mean(z>0)))
 print('H %d dates %d IC %.6f ICIR %.6f avgN %.2f hit %.4f'%rows[-1])
 if h==1:
  for name,mask in [('2020-25',sig.index<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',sig.index>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',sig.index>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',sig.index>='2029-01-01')]:
   q=[]
   for d in sig.index[mask]:
    ok=sig.loc[d].notna()&fwd.loc[d].notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:q.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[d,ok],fwd.loc[d,ok]).statistic)
   q=np.asarray(q); print(name,'dates',len(q),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(np.nanmean(q),np.nanmean(q)/np.nanstd(q,ddof=1)))
ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.index.name='date';sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20291101_tail_asymmetry_signal.csv')

from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-09-19')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

for s in syms:
 d=pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index()
 close[s]=d[d.index<=cutoff]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[x.index for x in close.values()]))
p=pd.DataFrame({s:close[s].reindex(idx) for s in syms},index=idx)
# Volatility-shock reversal: recent weakness is favored only when short-term vol has not exploded;
# cross-sectional ranks make the signal robust across heterogeneous asset scales.
sig=pd.DataFrame(index=idx,columns=syms,dtype=float)
for s in syms:
 x=close[s]; r=x.pct_change()
 ret5=x.pct_change(5); v20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); v60=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
 shock=(v20/(v60+1e-8)).clip(0.25,4)
 # contrarian short-term reversal, penalized by volatility shock and absolute risk
 raw=(-ret5/(v20+1e-8))/(1+0.8*(shock-1).clip(lower=0))
 sig[s]=raw.reindex(idx)
# lag to ensure no lookahead
sig=sig.shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   vals.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic); ns.append(ok.sum())
 vals=np.asarray(vals); ic=np.nanmean(vals); ir=ic/np.nanstd(vals,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)
 print(f'H {h} dates {len(vals)} IC {ic:.6f} ICIR {ir:.6f} avgN {np.mean(ns):.2f} hit {np.mean(vals>0):.4f}')
 if h==10:
  for name,mask in [('2020-25',sig.index<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',sig.index>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',sig.index>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',sig.index>='2029-01-01')]:
   x=[]
   for dt in sig.index[mask]:
    ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:x.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[dt,ok],fwd.loc[dt,ok]).statistic)
   x=np.asarray(x); print(name,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(np.nanmean(x),np.nanmean(x)/np.nanstd(x,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)))
ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.index.name='date';sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20290920_volshock_reversal_signal.csv')
"}

## Explored Factors

1. **Tail-Asymmetry / Downside-Participation-Adjusted Momentum**
   - 20-day return divided by 40-day downside volatility.
   - Multiplied by the ratio of upside to downside volatility, clipped to `[0.5, 2.0]`.
   - Applied a 10-day cross-asset breadth adjustment.
   - Signal lagged by one trading day to avoid look-ahead bias.
   - Tested across all 15 tradable instruments through **2029-10-31**.

2. **Breadth-Conditioned Low-Volatility Stability**
   - Inverse 20-day realized volatility.
   - Adjusted toward defensive low-volatility exposure when cross-asset breadth weakened.
   - Signal lagged by one day.
   - Tested across all 15 tradable instruments through **2029-10-31**.

## Validation Results

### Tail-Asymmetry Momentum

| Horizon | Dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1D | 1,843 | 14.38 | 0.013717 | 0.045602 | 51.60% |
| 5D | 1,838 | 14.32 | -0.003825 | -0.012293 | 48.64% |
| 10D | 1,491 | 14.18 | 0.000696 | 0.002157 | 49.36% |
| 20D | 2,148 | 14.22 | 0.035010 | 0.105835 | 53.72% |

Regime diagnostics for the 1-day horizon:

| Regime | Dates | IC | ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2020–2025 | 904 | 0.028600 | 0.088011 |
| 2026 onward | 939 | -0.000610 | -0.002220 |
| 2028 onward | 477 | 0.007622 | 0.028317 |
| 2029 YTD | 217 | 0.007809 | 0.030964 |

Additional diagnostics:

- Coverage: **78.56%**
- Rank turnover: **0.129481**
- Average daily cross-section: approximately **14.2–14.4 instruments**
- Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20291101_tail_asymmetry_signal.csv`

The factor showed a promising 20-day relationship, with IC of **0.035010** and ICIR of **0.105835**, but it failed the benchmark admission requirement on the daily horizon: daily ICIR was only **0.045602**, below the required **0.0840**. Its daily relationship also weakened materially after 2025.

### Breadth-Conditioned Low-Volatility Stability

| Horizon | Dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |

| 1D | 2,194 | 14.61 | 0.003719 | 0.010709 | 50.09% |

| 20D | 2,173 | 14.52 | -0.010040 | -0.030506 | 50.71% |

Regime diagnostics for the 1-day horizon:

| Regime | Dates | IC | ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2020–2025 | 1,227 | -0.000676 | -0.001778 |
| 2026 onward | 967 | 0.009296 | 0.030886 |
| 2028 onward | 477 | 0.017049 | 0.060618 |
| 2029 YTD | 217 | 0.005283 | 0.018951 |

Additional diagnostics:

- Coverage: **99.67%**
- Rank turnover: **0.027943**
- Average daily cross-section: approximately **14.4–14.6 instruments**
- Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20291101_lowvol_stability_signal.csv`

The factor failed both daily admission thresholds. The daily IC was **0.003719**, below **0.0070**, and daily ICIR was **0.010709**, below **0.0840**. It also displayed negative medium-horizon predictive power.

## Persistence Actions

- **No factors persisted.**
- Tail-asymmetry momentum was retained as an audit artifact because of its stronger 20-day result, but it did not meet the required daily IC/ICIR admission gates.
- Low-volatility stability was not persisted because its daily and medium-horizon results were insufficient.
- No library-correlation metadata was required because neither candidate qualified for admission.

## Current Effective Factors

- No new effective factors were added in this cycle.
- Existing factor files remain unchanged.
- The results continue to support using defensive and low-volatility signals as portfolio constraints or conditional overlays rather than treating them as standalone alpha factors.

## Plans

- Test the tail-asymmetry signal as a strictly conditional overlay activated only during stressed breadth or volatility regimes.
- Examine 20-day horizon construction more carefully, including alignment with the strategy’s 10-trading-day rebalance schedule.
- Explore downside participation relative to defensive assets such as XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y.
- Continue monitoring whether the positive 2028–2029 low-volatility and tail-asymmetry behavior is persistent enough to justify a future conditional factor.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-11-14'); syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
close={s:pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index().loc[:cutoff] for s in syms}; idx=sorted(set().union(*[x.index for x in close.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:close[s].reindex(idx) for s in syms},index=idx); r=p.pct_change()
# Dual horizon trend consistency: medium trend, long trend, and path quality; all information lagged.
sig=pd.DataFrame(index=idx,columns=syms,dtype=float)
for s in syms:
 x=close[s]; rr=x.pct_change(); ret20=x.pct_change(20); ret60=x.pct_change(60); vol=rr.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std(); dd=x/x.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()-1
 path=(ret20.abs()/(rr.abs().rolling(20,min_periods=10).sum()+1e-8)).clip(0,2)
 # reward aligned positive trends, suppress drawdown and unstable paths
 consistency=(np.sign(ret20)*np.sign(ret60)).replace(0,1)
 sig[s]=((0.6*ret20/(vol*np.sqrt(20)+1e-8)+0.4*ret60/(rr.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(60)+1e-8))* (0.7+0.3*path) * consistency * (1+dd.clip(-.5,0))).reindex(idx)
sig=sig.shift(1)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for d in idx:
  ok=sig.loc[d].notna()&fwd.loc[d].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[d,ok],fwd.loc[d,ok]).statistic); ns.append(ok.sum())
 z=np.asarray(vals); print('H',h,'dates',len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f avgN %.2f hit %.4f'%(np.nanmean(z),np.nanmean(z)/np.nanstd(z,ddof=1),np.mean(ns),np.mean(z>0)))
 if h==1:
  for name,mask in [('2020-25',sig.index<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',sig.index>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',sig.index>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',sig.index>='2029-01-01')]:
   q=[]
   for d in sig.index[mask]:
    ok=sig.loc[d].notna()&fwd.loc[d].notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:q.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[d,ok],fwd.loc[d,ok]).statistic)
   q=np.asarray(q); print(name,'dates',len(q),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(np.nanmean(q),np.nanmean(q)/np.nanstd(q,ddof=1)))
ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())); sig.index.name='date'; sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20291115_dual_horizon_consistency_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-12-12')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
cs={s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index().loc[:cutoff] for s in syms}
ix=sorted(set().union(*[x.index for x in cs.values()]))
p=pd.DataFrame({s:cs[s].reindex(ix) for s in syms}); r=p.pct_change()
# Relative-strength persistence: asset's 20d return relative to contemporaneous universe median,
# volatility normalized and stabilized by a 60d trend-consistency multiplier.
ret20=p/p.shift(20)-1
relative=ret20.sub(ret20.median(axis=1),axis=0)
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()
trend60=p/p.shift(60)-1
cons=(r.rolling(60,min_periods=30).mean()>0).astype(float)
cons=cons.rolling(20,min_periods=10).mean()
sig=(relative/(vol+1e-8)*(0.75+0.5*cons)*(1+trend60.clip(-.2,.2)/.2)).shift(1)
print('cutoff',cutoff.date(),'assets',len(syms),'dates',len(ix))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 f=p.shift(-h)/p-1; z=[];ns=[]
 for d in ix:
  ok=sig.loc[d].notna()&f.loc[d].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   z.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[d,ok],f.loc[d,ok]).statistic);ns.append(ok.sum())
 z=np.asarray(z)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(z),'avgN %.2f IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(np.mean(ns),np.mean(z),np.mean(z)/np.std(z,ddof=1),np.mean(z>0)))
 if h==1:
  for name,m in [('2020-25',sig.index<'2026-01-01'),('2026+',sig.index>='2026-01-01'),('2028+',sig.index>='2028-01-01'),('2029YTD',sig.index>='2029-01-01')]:
   q=[]
   for d in sig.index[m]:
    ok=sig.loc[d].notna()&f.loc[d].notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:q.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[d,ok],f.loc[d,ok]).statistic)
   q=np.asarray(q); print(name,'dates',len(q),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)))
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.index.name='date';sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20291213_relative_momentum_signal.csv')

for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 f=p.shift(-h)/p-1; z=[];ns=[]

 z=np.asarray(z); print('H',h,'dates',len(z),'avgN %.2f IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(np.mean(ns),np.mean(z),np.mean(z)/np.std(z,ddof=1),np.mean(z>0)))
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2029-12-26')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
cs={s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index().loc[:cutoff] for s in syms}
ix=sorted(set().union(*[x.index for x in cs.values()]))
p=pd.DataFrame({s:cs[s].reindex(ix) for s in syms}); r=p.pct_change()
# Shock-reversal within durable trend: fade the latest 5d cross-sectional shock,
# but only where 40d trend agrees with the opposite direction; scale by downside/upside volatility.
ret5=p/p.shift(5)-1; tr40=p/p.shift(40)-1
med5=ret5.median(axis=1); shock=ret5.sub(med5,axis=0)
vol20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# reversal is strongest for negative shock in positive trend and vice versa, normalized for risk
sig=(-shock/(1+3*vol20) * np.sign(tr40)).shift(1)
# retain broad coverage; sign gate is continuous and does not drop names
sig.index.name='date'; sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20291227_shock_reversal_signal.csv')
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 f=p.shift(-h)/p-1; z=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for d in ix:
  ok=sig.loc[d].notna()&f.loc[d].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   z.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[d,ok],f.loc[d,ok]).statistic); ns.append(ok.sum()); ds.append(d)
 z=np.asarray(z)
 print(f'H {h} dates {len(z)} avgN {np.mean(ns):.2f} IC {np.mean(z):.6f} ICIR {np.mean(z)/np.std(z,ddof=1):.6f} hit {np.mean(z>0):.4f}')
 if h==1:
  for name,lo,hi in [('2020-25','2020-01-01','2025-12-31'),('2026+','2026-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028+','2028-01-01','2028-12-31'),('2029YTD','2029-01-01','2029-12-26')]:
   q=z[np.array([(d>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(d<=pd.Timestamp(hi)) for d in ds])]
   print(name,'dates',len(q),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(np.mean(q),np.mean(q)/np.std(q,ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan))
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2029-12-26')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Volatility-balanced defensive carry: downside/upside semivolatility balance plus medium trend,
# with cross-sectional ranking to reduce scale differences across asset classes.
up=r.clip(lower=0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std(); dn=(-r.clip(upper=0)).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()
balance=np.log((up+1e-8)/(dn+1e-8)); trend=px.pct_change(20)
f=(balance.rank(axis=1,pct=True)+0.5*trend.rank(axis=1,pct=True)).shift(1)
f.index.name='date'; f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20291227_balance_trend_signal.csv')
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 I=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);ds.append(px.index[i]);ns.append(len(q))
 a=np.array(I); d=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avgN %.2f IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(np.mean(ns),a.mean(),a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),np.mean(a>0)))
 if h==1:
  for lab,m in [('2020-25',(d<pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01'))),('2026+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2028+',d>=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01')),('2029YTD',d>=pd.Timestamp('2029-01-01'))]:
   x=a[m]; print(lab,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)))
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f dates %d assets %d'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),len(px),len(U)))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2030-01-09')
syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
cs={s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index().loc[:cutoff] for s in syms}
ix=sorted(set().union(*[x.index for x in cs.values()]))
p=pd.DataFrame({s:cs[s].reindex(ix) for s in syms}); r=p.pct_change()
# Trend persistence: medium-term return, confirmed by directional breadth, risk scaled.
ret60=p/p.shift(60)-1
breadth20=(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()/r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).abs().mean()).clip(-1,1)
vol40=r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
sig=(ret60*breadth20/(1+2*vol40)).shift(1)
sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300110_persistent_trend_signal.csv')
allz={}
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 f=p.shift(-h)/p-1; z=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for d in ix:
  ok=sig.loc[d].notna()&f.loc[d].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   z.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[d,ok],f.loc[d,ok]).statistic);ns.append(ok.sum());ds.append(d)
 z=np.asarray(z); allz[h]=z
 print(f'H {h} dates {len(z)} avgN {np.mean(ns):.2f} IC {np.mean(z):.6f} ICIR {np.mean(z)/np.std(z,ddof=1):.6f} hit {np.mean(z>0):.4f}')
 if h==1:
  for name,lo,hi in [('2020-25','2020-01-01','2025-12-31'),('2026-27','2026-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028','2028-01-01','2028-12-31'),('2029','2029-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-01-09')]:
   q=z[np.array([(d>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(d<=pd.Timestamp(hi)) for d in ds])]
   print(name,len(q),np.mean(q) if len(q) else np.nan,(np.mean(q)/np.std(q,ddof=1)) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
print('coverage',sig.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover',sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())

from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

cs={s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in syms}; ix=sorted(set().union(*[x.index for x in cs.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:cs[s].reindex(ix) for s in syms}); r=p.pct_change()
# Breakout quality: proximity to 120d high combined with positive 20d return, normalized by volatility.
dd=p/p.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max()-1; ret20=p/p.shift(20)-1; vol40=r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)

for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 f=p.shift(-h)/p-1; z=[];ns=[]
 for d in ix:
  ok=sig.loc[d].notna()&f.loc[d].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:z.append(spearmanr(sig.loc[d,ok],f.loc[d,ok]).statistic);ns.append(ok.sum())
